q1.explanationZh: campus 名词“校园”，on campus“在校园里”。

q2.explanationZh: can 作情态动词“会；能够”；另一个同形词 can 作名词“罐头”，作动词“装罐”。

q3.explanationZh: canal 名词“运河”，如 the Panama Canal“巴拿马运河”。

q4.explanationZh: cancel 及物动词“取消”，过去式 cancelled（美式 canceled）。

q5.explanationZh: cancer 名词“癌症”，cancer patients“癌症患者”。

q6.explanationZh: candidate 名词“候选人；求职者”。

q7.explanationZh: candle 名词“蜡烛”，light a candle“点蜡烛”。

q8.explanationZh: candy 是美式英语的“糖果”，a box of candy“一盒糖果”。

q9.explanationZh: canteen 名词“食堂；小卖部”，注意结尾是 -een。

q10.explanationZh: cap 名词“便帽”，动词“覆盖”，过去式双写 p：capped。

q11.explanationZh: capable 形容词“有能力的”，常用 be capable of (doing) sth.。

q12.explanationZh: capacity 名词“容量；能力”，a seating capacity of 2,000“能容纳2000人”。

q13.explanationZh: capital 名词“首都；资本；大写字母”，也可作形容词“主要的；大写的”。

q15.explanationZh: captain 名词“船长；队长”，注意结尾拼作 -tain。

q16.explanationZh: capture 动词、名词同形，“捕获；俘虏”。

q17.explanationZh: car 名词“汽车；（火车）车厢”。

q18.explanationZh: carbon 名词“碳”，carbon dioxide“二氧化碳”。

q19.explanationZh: card 名词“卡片”，greeting card“贺卡”。

q20.explanationZh: care 不及物动词“关心；介意”，名词“照管；小心”，take care of“照顾”。

q21.explanationZh: career 名词“生涯；职业”，指一生从事的职业，可数。

q22.explanationZh: care 加 -ful 构成形容词 careful“小心的”。

q23.explanationZh: care 加 -less 构成形容词 careless“粗心的”，与 careful 相反。

q24.explanationZh: cargo 名词“（船、飞机等装载的）货物”。

q26.explanationZh: carpet 名词“地毯”，lay a carpet“铺地毯”。

q27.explanationZh: carriage 名词“马车；（火车）车厢”，由 carry 变来，注意 y 变 i。

q28.explanationZh: carrot 名词“胡萝卜”，注意双写 r。

q29.explanationZh: carry 及物动词“运送；携带”，过去式 carried。

q31.explanationZh: cartoon 名词“动画片；漫画”，重音在第二个音节。

q32.explanationZh: carve 及物动词“雕刻；划分”，过去式 carved。

q33.explanationZh: be capable of sth.“有做某事的能力”，介词用 of，后接名词或动名词。

q34.explanationZh: capital 作形容词有“主要的”意思，a capital ship“一艘主舰”。

q35.explanationZh: care about“关心，在乎”，介词用 about。

q36.explanationZh: take care of 和 care for 都可表示“照顾，照料”。

q37.explanationZh: a box of“一盒……”，candy 在这里作不可数名词。

q38.explanationZh: lay 表示“铺设”，lay a carpet“铺地毯”。

q39.explanationZh: by + 交通工具（不加冠词）表示乘坐方式，go by carriage“乘马车去”。

q40.explanationZh: carry on“继续；进行”，后可接名词或 with sth.。

q41.explanationZh: carry out“实行，执行”，如 carry out a plan。

q42.explanationZh: carry ... away 有“拿走”的意思，也可表示“使激动而失去自我控制力”，常用 be/get carried away。

q43.explanationZh: carry ... back“把……带回去”，也可表示“使忆起”，如 The song carried me back to my childhood.

q44.explanationZh: be capable of“有能力（做）”，of 后接名词或动名词。

q45.explanationZh: “这个容器可装5升水”，this 后接可数名词单数，can 作名词“罐，容器”。

q46.explanationZh: be capable of“有能力做”，are 后接形容词 capable。

q47.explanationZh: carve ... into“把……划分成”，was 后用过去分词 carved 构成被动语态。

q48.explanationZh: “毕业后想从事什么职业”，a 后接可数名词单数 career。

q49.explanationZh: 谚语 Care and diligence bring luck.“谨慎勤奋，好运自来”，care 作名词“小心”。

q50.explanationZh: the 后接名词，capture 作名词“捕获”。

q51.explanationZh: a cargo of“一船（货物）”，cargo 指船、飞机等装载的货物。

q52.explanationZh: 与 science fiction 比较的是一类作品，用复数 cartoons“漫画”。

q53.explanationZh: 修饰名词 drivers 用形容词，“粗心的司机”是 careless drivers。

q54.explanationZh: the Panama Canal“巴拿马运河”，专有名词首字母大写。

q55.explanationZh: greeting card“贺卡”，泛指时用复数 cards。

q57.explanationZh: 修饰名词 plan 用形容词，a careful plan“周密的计划”。

q58.sampleAnswer: The new software is capable of processing data at a speed greater than expected.
references: The new software is capable of processing data at a speed greater than expected.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q58.explanationZh: be capable of 后接动名词 processing；“超出预期的速度”= a speed greater than expected。

q59.sampleAnswer: We can learn much by reading about the careers of great men.
references: We can learn much by reading about the careers of great men.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q59.explanationZh: “一生经历”用 career“生涯”，指多位伟人用复数 careers；“获益匪浅”= learn much。

q60.sampleAnswer: For the moment we’ve been told to carry on as usual.
references: For the moment we’ve been told to carry on as usual.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q60.explanationZh: carry on“继续进行”；“被告知”用被动 be told to do；“目前”= for the moment。

q61.sampleAnswer: The old man has no children, but his niece has been taking good care of his daily life.
references: The old man has no children, but his niece has been taking good care of his daily life.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: “一直在照料”用现在完成进行时 has been taking；“悉心照料”= take good care of。

q62.sampleAnswer: With a series of favourable policies carried out, the electric vehicle company is optimistic about advancing battery technology into international markets.
references: With a series of favourable policies carried out, the electric vehicle company is optimistic about advancing battery technology into international markets.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: “随着政策落地”用 with + 名词 + 过去分词 carried out（政策被实施）；“对……乐观”= be optimistic about。

q63.sampleAnswer: We shouldn’t hurry all the way to the airport; the flight was cancelled because of the foggy weather.
references: We shouldn’t hurry all the way to the airport; the flight was cancelled because of the foggy weather.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: 航班“被取消”用被动语态 was cancelled；“因为有雾”= because of the foggy weather。

q64.sampleAnswer: What other factors are there that have worked wonders on these cancer patients apart from the change in their lifestyles?
references: What other factors are there that have worked wonders on these cancer patients apart from the change in their lifestyles?

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: “癌症患者”= cancer patients；“创造奇迹”= work wonders；“除了”= apart from。

q65.sampleAnswer: As long as you know how to reflect on your mistakes, you can learn lessons from them.
references: As long as you know how to reflect on your mistakes, you can learn lessons from them.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: “只要”= as long as；“能”用情态动词 can，后接动词原形 learn。

q66.sampleAnswer: It is not book knowledge but practical experience that many candidates lack nowadays.
references: It is not book knowledge but practical experience that many candidates lack nowadays.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: 用强调句 It is ... that ...，“不是……而是……”= not ... but ...；“求职者”= candidates。

q67.sampleAnswer: As was expected beforehand, many parents who attended the parents’ meeting volunteered to take on the responsibility of campus inspectors.
references: As was expected beforehand, many parents who attended the parents’ meeting volunteered to take on the responsibility of campus inspectors.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q67.explanationZh: “正如之前预料的”= as was expected beforehand；“校园检查员”= campus inspectors；“承担职务”= take on the responsibility。
